name: AP_PAYMENT_TEMPLATES
description:
The AP_PAYMENT_TEMPLATES table contains the user defined Payment Process Request Templates. The Templates can be used to default the Invoice Selection Critera in AP_INV_SELECTION_CRITERIA_ALL.

This table corresponds to the Create Payment Request Template page.

columns.name: TEMPLATE_ID
columns.description: System generated primary key for  payment template.

columns.name: TEMPLATE_NAME
columns.description: Payment Process Request Template Name

columns.name: TEMPLATE_TYPE
columns.description: Payment Process Request Template Type. Values, from the lookup PAYMENT_TEMPLATE_TYPE

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Payment Process Request Template Description

columns.name: INACTIVE_DATE
columns.description: End Date for the Payment Process Request Template

columns.name: ADDL_PAY_FROM_DAYS
columns.description: Number of pay from days defined in the payment template. The value can be either zero or a positive number.

columns.name: ADDL_PAY_THRU_DAYS
columns.description: End date in a date range that indicates the date until when the invoices are selected.

columns.name: HI_PAYMENT_PRIORITY
columns.description: Highest payment priority of the documents to select

columns.name: LOW_PAYMENT_PRIORITY
columns.description: Lowest payment priority of the documents to select

columns.name: PAY_ONLY_WHEN_DUE_FLAG
columns.description: Flag that indicates if documents will be selected by their due date only (Y or N)

columns.name: ZERO_INV_ALLOWED_FLAG
columns.description: Flag indicating whether scheduled payments with zero amount remaining will be selected during a pay run

columns.name: VENDOR_TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE
columns.description: Supplier Type. Based on PO Lookup Type VENDOR TYPES

columns.name: VENDOR_ID
columns.description: Unique supplier identifier from the supplier tables.

columns.name: PARTY_ID
columns.description: Party identifier of the payment template.

columns.name: PAYMENT_METHOD_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the payment methods, such as check, cash, or credit.

columns.name: INV_EXCHANGE_RATE_TYPE
columns.description: Type of conversion rate between the payment and your ledger currency.

columns.name: PAY_GROUP_OPTION
columns.description: Pay Group Options, All and Specify

columns.name: CURRENCY_GROUP_OPTION
columns.description: Currency Options, All and Specify

columns.description: Operating Unit Options, All and Specify

columns.description: Payment Date Options, Same as the Request Date, Extra Days

columns.name: ADDL_PAYMENT_DAYS
columns.description: Extra payment days in the payment template.

columns.name: BANK_ACCOUNT_ID
columns.description: The Internal bank account identifier

columns.name: BANK_CHARGE_BEARER
columns.description: Bearer of bank charge cost. Bank charge bearers are defined as the lookup IBY_BANK_CHARGE_BEARER

columns.name: SETTLEMENT_PRIORITY
columns.description: Overrides the invoice value for Oracle Payments' bank charges feature.

columns.name: FIRST_VOUCHER_NUMBER
columns.description: First available voucher number in document sequence for payment batch document category

columns.name: TRANSFER_PRIORITY
columns.description: Transfer priority defined in payment template. This can be express, normal, and any.

columns.name: PAYMENT_EXCHANGE_RATE_TYPE
columns.description: Exchange rate type for a foreign currency payment

columns.name: PAYMENT_PROFILE_ID
columns.description: Payment process profile identifier

columns.name: ZERO_AMOUNTS_ALLOWED
columns.description: Flag indicating whether zero payments allowed in run. Helps in Maximizing credits

columns.name: PAYABLES_REVIEW_SETTINGS

columns.name: CALC_AWT_INT_FLAG

columns.name: PAYMENTS_REVIEW_SETTINGS
columns.description: If this check box is selected, the Build Payments program runs to group the invoices into payments and the pay run pauses after payments have been built to allow you to review the proposed payments.

columns.name: CREATE_INSTRS_FLAG
columns.description: Payment Instruction Creation Program. This setting requires the user to select a payment process profile. This setting will also ensure that payments from this payment process request are not combined with payments from other payment process requests when the system creates payment instructions

columns.name: DOCUMENT_REJECTION_LEVEL_CODE

columns.name: PAYMENT_REJECTION_LEVEL_CODE

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
